Member and billing support

Clear help before and after purchase.

No paid Franklin Navigator subscription is active through this site today. This page explains the support, cancellation and recovery standards that must be operating before checkout opens.

Email supportCall (615) 656-7020

Before purchase

Review regular pricing, the Founding30 first-12-month terms, renewal timing, included benefits and cancellation access.

After verified payment

Receive account/profile linkage, membership confirmation, selected benefits, Growth Desk first value and self-service billing access.

Payment problems

Payment failure, grace, suspension, recovery, refund and renewal must be reflected accurately in the member’s Franklin account.

Cancellation

Cancel-at-period-end is the expected default. Access remains through the paid period unless a refund or safety correction requires another result.
